previous_sql: SELECT merchant_sk, trade_name, risk_tier, settlement_currency, fee_minor, interchange_minor, scheme_fee_minor, gross_eur_minor, net_eur_minor FROM fact_settlement_batch JOIN dim_merchant ON fact_settlement_batch.merchant_id = dim_merchant.merchant_id WHERE dim_merchant.is_current = 1 AND dim_merchant.risk_tier IS NOT NULL GROUP BY merchant_sk, trade_name, risk_tier, settlement_currency, fee_minor, interchange_minor, scheme_fee_minor, gross_eur_minor, net_eur_minor ORDER BY gross_eur_minor DESC

sql: SELECT m.merchant_sk, m.trade_name, m.risk_tier, s.fee_minor, s.interchange_minor, s.scheme_fee_minor, s.gross_eur_minor, s.net_eur_minor FROM fact_settlement_batch s JOIN dim_merchant m ON s.merchant_id = m.merchant_id WHERE m.is_current = 1 AND m.risk_tier IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.merchant_sk, m.trade_name, m.risk_tier, m.settlement_currency, s.fee_minor, s.interchange_minor, s.scheme_fee_minor, s.gross_eur_minor, s.net_eur_minor ORDER BY s.gross_eur_minor DESC
